name: OPA order decision — the e2e default

result.message: The e2e stub allows anything it has not been told to refuse

why: The portal asks this path for every order while an OPA integration exists (#110).
Priority 9 so a mapping a test registers at runtime can refuse one project and
leave every other order in the shard alone. This stub is deliberately the
PERMISSIVE fallback: if a test leaves an integration behind, the next test's
orders are allowed rather than refused by a stub that happens to be gone.
